audience: ecommerce brands that fulfill orders through ShipBob

useCases.title: Follow an order from shipment to delivery
useCases.text: List the shipments of one order. Read the status history of a shipment, and look up carrier tracking events by tracking number.

useCases.title: Check stock across fulfillment centers
useCases.text: Read inventory items by SKU, with on-hand, committed and available stock. List the fulfillment centers of the account.

useCases.title: Follow inbound stock still in transit
useCases.text: List the warehouse receiving orders for stock on its way to a fulfillment center. Open one to read its status and expected items.

useCases.title: Create a fulfillment order for a channel
useCases.text: Read the channel id of your store first. Then create an order for ShipBob to pick, pack and ship. The order can incur shipping and fulfillment fees.

useCases.title: Cancel an order that has not shipped
useCases.text: Read the order first. Cancel it only if it has not shipped, because ShipBob may refuse a cancel after picking starts.
